note: Split engine. calculateSmrGrade(state) returns { medicineCount, regularMedicineCount, anticholinergicBurdenScore, polypharmacyBand, anticholinergicBand, burdenBand, reviewStatus, stopFlags, startFlags, firedRules } - no timestamp. Bands: regular >= 10 hyperpolypharmacy / >= 5 polypharmacy / else none; ACB >= 3 significant; burdenBand is the worse of the two (high if either hyperpolypharmacy or ACB >= 3, moderate if polypharmacy, else low). firedRules ALWAYS carries the four summary rows R-POLYPHARMACY-01, R-ANTICHOLINERGIC-BURDEN-01, R-BURDEN-BAND-01, R-REVIEW-STATUS-01 (even for an empty review), followed by one R-STOPP-01 per medicine with a stoppCriterion and then one R-START-01 per startCriterion - the STOPP/START ids repeat, so rule count = 4 + stopFlags + startFlags. Flags are a SEPARATE export mirrored from form-app.js submitForm(): detectFlaggedIssues(state, grade), so flagsArgs is ["state", "result"]. Quirks verified: a null anticholinergicBurdenPoints contributes 0; only isRegular === 'yes' counts toward polypharmacy (medicineCount still counts PRN rows); reviewStatus is 'complete' only when problems, whatMatters, monitoringDue, sharedDecisions are filled, reviewCompleted === 'yes', AND every medicine has an indication and an adherence that is neither '' nor 'unknown' - so a single 'unknown' adherence forces 'incomplete' even when the clinician marked the review done, while 'unknown' does NOT raise F-ADHERENCE-CONCERN-001 (that needs partial/poor); a monitoringUpToDate of 'na' or '' is not a gap (only 'no'); F-HIGH-RISK-NO-INDICATION-001 fires for isHighRisk 'yes' when indicationRecorded === 'no' OR the indication text is blank (either is enough, so a documented indication with indicationRecorded 'no' still flags); F-MISSING-MONITORING-001 joins the per-medicine gap count and overdueMonitoringCount with '; '; the adherence / high-risk name lists fall back to 'Medicine N' where N is the index in the FILTERED list, not the medicine list. Flags are stable-sorted high > medium > low in push order (ACB, STOPP, MONITORING, HIGH-RISK, then START, ADHERENCE, then INCOMPLETE). ORACLE LIMITATION: bin/test-personas only calls the split detector when the grader result has no key matching /flag|issue/i that is an array - and this grader's own stopFlags / startFlags match that heuristic - so expected carries NO flaggedIssues key for this form even though flagsHint/flagsArgs are set (they still document the real form-app.js contract). The flaggedIssues listed in each persona description were verified by calling detectFlaggedIssues(state, grade) directly in node against the pinned state. Regenerate expected with: bin/test-personas structured-medication-review --update

personas.name: Care-home hyperpolypharmacy - ACB 7, lithium and warfarin unmonitored
personas.description: Eileen Prendergast, 85 and over, severe frailty, care-home resident reviewed on a home visit. Eleven medicines, ten regular (paracetamol PRN, ACB null contributes 0). ACB = amitriptyline 3 + oxybutynin 3 + furosemide 1 = 7. STOPP criteria on amitriptyline and oxybutynin; START (folic acid) on the methotrexate row.
